blocks.text: One Word. A world to discover.
Read the Scriptures. Follow the connections. Bring your questions. See the bigger story.
Free to explore. Open to everyone. 160 Bible versions · 140 languages
Two thousand years of faith, gathered in one place.

For two thousand years believers have copied the Scriptures, confessed the creeds, preached, argued and prayed. Most of that inheritance survives, but it is scattered across libraries and archives, in books long out of print, and much of it behind a paywall. Bible Guide gathers it into one source and gives it away, for the glory of God.

The Bible to read slowly, in the version you love or two side by side, with every passage linked to the others that echo it. Around the text: the places on the map, the creeds and confessions, the teachers of the Church across the centuries, and honest answers to the questions people have always asked.
A library with a paper trail
Every work here is traced back to where it came from: who wrote it, when, and which edition it was taken from, so you can always check what you read against its source.

Open a book, a single verse, a question or a place on the map: everything is linked to everything else, so one thread leads to the next. The reader remembers where you stopped, so each visit picks up where the last one ended.
Choose the one closest to you, and we'll take you to the right place.
Every page is offered back to the One it is about: the Almighty, the Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the ending, worthy of all praise.
“Whatsoever ye do, do all to the glory of God.” 1 CORINTHIANS 10:31
There is no subscription and nothing to buy. What the Church received as a gift should be passed on as one.
“Freely ye have received, freely give.” MATTHEW 10:8
Believer or skeptic, scholar or simply curious: the door is open to anyone who wants to come in.
“Ho, every one that thirsteth, come ye to the waters.” ISAIAH 55:1
Scripture, the creeds, the teachers and the hard questions, scattered for centuries, brought into one source and linked together.
“Wisdom is the principal thing; therefore get wisdom.” PROVERBS 4:7

Every word, traced to its source.

Nothing here is anonymous. Every edition, book, sermon and map layer is held as it was downloaded, with its licence and its origin on record, and credited where it is used. When a source is uncertain, or a place is disputed, we say so.

Find your way, close to home.

Faith is meant to be lived with others, close to where you are. Find a church to belong to, and a fellowship or Bible study where you can know people and be known through the week. And for the hardest days there is help nearby: food pantries, shelter, pregnancy centers, safety from abuse, recovery from addiction, grief care and support for families.
245 places and 14 phone lines: churches and Bible studies, and help for hard times, each checked on its own page.
